subject.title: fix(agents): preserve media side merges during prompt release

question: Should this PR merge the active-leaf-preserving side-leaf exception as the session-state boundary for prompt-released media delivery mirrors?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes when unowned prompt-released leaf controls are merged instead of treated as takeover, which needs owner acceptance.

options.title: Accept the guarded boundary
options.body: Proceed once exact-head CI is green and the release-owned changelog edit is removed or explicitly accepted for this maintainer branch.

options.title: Ask for a stricter guard
options.body: Require additional validation or tests if maintainers want the side-leaf exception tied to a narrower delivery-mirror contract before merge.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Reject the branch if maintainers prefer false takeover failures over admitting any unowned leaf-control merge path.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed once exact-head CI is green and the release-owned changelog edit is removed or explicitly accepted for this maintainer branch.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the replacement branch and is the clearest owner for the maintainer-labeled session-state boundary choice.
